description: Compare current prices between 2-5 commodities side by side. Use when the user asks to compare commodities (e.g., 'Brent vs WTI', 'US gas vs EU gas'). Returns each commodity's price with 24h changes, plus the spread if comparing two same-currency commodities. Accepts natural language or codes.

commodities.description: List of 2-5 commodity names or codes to compare (e.g., ['brent', 'wti'] or ['NATURAL_GAS_USD', 'DUTCH_TTF_EUR'])

name: opa_compare_prices
title: Compare Commodity Prices
